review_notes: An AI assistant (Claude) inspected all 16 contact sheets on 2026-11-21, before any outcome of participants 014 to 150 was computed. BF: all 298 participant-side panels show toes and forefoot above the heel; the big toe lies at low columns for Right and high columns for Left, in agreement with the metadata. ST: all 298 outsole panels are upright and paired; toe anatomy is hidden by the outsole, so side assignment rests on the metadata, supported by the paired BF maps. Faint but upright panels: 083 (small footprint, both conditions) and 104 ST Right (low, patchy pressure). No structural orientation or labelling failure seen. Automatic check: 596 groups of 12 selected steps, none flagged, lowest value 9.13 cells against a threshold of 5. All 149 participants supplied 12 eligible steps per side in both conditions; no trial was unavailable. This was not a human inspection. An author must repeat it before submission. No coverage outcome was examined in this review.
